text: Question: I was charged twice for the same recharge — how do I get a refund? Answer: ### Short Answer Duplicate-charge refunds are usually auto-detected and reversed within 3-5 working days. If not, raise a ticket under Billing > Report Issue with both transaction references; approved refunds are credited to the original payment method or as account balance. ### Detailed Explanation Auto-detection is the default path (3-5 working days), and the manual ticket route exists specifically as the fallback for when auto-detection doesn't catch it — the two transaction references are needed precisely because it's a duplicate-charge case, so the system needs to see both transactions to link them. ### Key Details | Detail | Value | |---|---| | Default handling | Auto-detected and reversed within 3-5 working days | | If not auto-resolved | Raise a ticket under Billing > Report Issue with both transaction references | | Where refund lands | Original payment method, or as account balance | ### Troubleshooting | Symptom | Possible Cause | Diagnostic Check | Recommended Action | |---|---|---|---| | Duplicate charge, <5 working days since it occurred | Still within the auto-detection and reversal window | Whether the duplicate has been auto-reversed yet | Wait out the standard 3-5 working day window first | | Duplicate charge, 5+ working days, not reversed | Auto-detection did not catch this instance | Both transaction references for the duplicate charges | Raise a ticket under Billing > Report Issue with both references | ### Escalation
title: I was charged twice for the same recharge — how do I get a refund?
